scope: ALPHA12: historical 37-case regression carried forward, not rerun in full. The separate 9-case original TV guide checklist is documented in VALIDATION.md.

cases.name: Moving Pictures views
cases.evidence: ALPHA8 list, normal and large thumbnail results carried forward. ALPHA9 filmstrip first selected cover is fully inside the left edge with X=60/width=1800. Right changes selected cover and title. Coverflow renders all three synthetic covers and Right changes the centered selection/title. Checked in isolated MP 1.39 x64.

cases.name: Moving Pictures details
cases.evidence: Movie summary/details tabs switch by mouse; title, synopsis, score, watched flag, genre and media icons render from synthetic metadata. Blank cast/director match unseeded fixture fields.

cases.name: Moving Pictures rating
cases.evidence: Rate Movie dialog opens; Right changes 3/5 to 4/5 with matching stars/caption. Cancelled without online submission.

cases.name: TVSeries seasons
cases.evidence: With SkipSeasonViewOnSingleSeason disabled in the isolated profile, the Season 1 row, three episode count and series-season title render and open correctly.

cases.name: TVSeries episode information
cases.evidence: After standard Home-to-TVSeries activation and four-second idle delay, episode info shows synthetic plot, thumbnail, aired date and media icon. Empty director/writer/rating are unseeded fixture fields.

cases.name: TVSeries rating
cases.evidence: The local synthetic series uses offline ID -1; the episode context and Actions menus do not expose a rating command. Online rating/account behavior remains unverified.

cases.name: OnlineVideos category navigation
cases.evidence: OnlineVideos opens language groups, German site list and ARD Live TV/Sendungen A-Z/Programm categories with icons and description. Existing definitions retained; playback and automatic site updates are outside this check.

cases.name: Sudoku page
cases.evidence: New Game populates all nine Sudoku columns while synthetic music continues. Removing the shared now-playing overlay prevents it covering the right-hand cells; title spelling corrected.

cases.name: Tetris page
cases.evidence: Tetris New Game starts at level 1 with visible falling blocks and results. Widened New Game/Sounds captions fit; music overlay no longer covers gameplay.

cases.name: German UI
cases.evidence: German music files, playlist and topbar render during input regression.

cases.name: English UI
cases.evidence: English native Settings labels, date and navigation render correctly; fixture titles retain Unicode.

cases.name: French UI
cases.evidence: French native labels render accents and fit Settings navigation; custom untranslated labels use English fallback.

cases.name: Russian UI
cases.evidence: Russian Settings, date, navigation and translated GuideRows caption render Cyrillic correctly. Long native prefix caption scrolls/clips within its button.

cases.name: Chinese UI
cases.evidence: Simplified Chinese Settings navigation and GuideRows caption render CJK characters using runtime fallback. Untranslated native/custom strings retain English.

cases.name: Default theme render
cases.evidence: Default Backdrop assets render in the isolated MP 1.39 x64 runtime.

cases.name: Installed theme selector inventory
cases.evidence: Theme selector opens and offers only Skin default, matching the absence of additional theme directories.

cases.name: Back
cases.evidence: Mouse Back returned from the playlist to BasicHome.

cases.name: Home
cases.evidence: Topbar Home returned from GUI/Skin settings to BasicHome after live language switching.

cases.name: Previous track
cases.evidence: Topbar Previous moved Input test 3 back to Input test 2, with the corrected skip-back artwork.

cases.name: Rewind
cases.evidence: Focused Rewind action 17 sets BASS speed -2; displayed position falls from 0:33 to 0:30. Immediate mouse focus and activation are not reliable in this automation session.

cases.name: Play
cases.evidence: With the synthetic track paused at 1:28 using the native shortcut, a mouse click on Play resolved its dynamic action to 12 and BASS resumed the same stream. The position advanced to 1:30 and 1:48 without restarting. When not paused, Play retains action 68; existing playlist start/restart semantics remain.

cases.name: Pause
cases.evidence: Topbar mouse pause held the playback position at 1:01 across later observations.

cases.name: Stop
cases.evidence: Focused Stop action ends playback and removes the now-playing overlay; the playlist and selected track remain visible.

cases.name: Fast forward
cases.evidence: Focused Fast forward action 16 produces BASS playback speed 2 and accelerated progress. Mouse focusing and keyboard activation were both exercised; video playback speed remains a separate check.

cases.name: Next track
cases.evidence: Topbar Next advanced the running multi-track fixture from Input test 2 to Input test 3.

cases.name: Fullscreen player toggle
cases.evidence: Topbar action 18 opened Music Now Playing from BasicHome during audio playback; Escape returned to the previous navigation screen.

cases.name: Exit button
cases.evidence: Native action 97 closed the isolated MediaPortal process normally. This is Exit, not operating-system shutdown; no OS power action was invoked.

cases.name: Photos category mouse area
cases.evidence: Clicking the Photos caption focuses its category and opens its submenu.

cases.name: Music category mouse area
cases.evidence: Clicking Music and Radio opens its vertical submenu at the visible caption.

cases.name: Movies category mouse area
cases.evidence: Movies caption opens its category submenu; synthetic movie fanart and title render.

cases.name: TV category mouse area
cases.evidence: TV caption click opens TV guide, recording and series submenu without entering a tuner page.

cases.name: Games category mouse area
cases.evidence: Games and Sports mouse caption opens Sudoku and Tetris submenu.

cases.name: Plugins category mouse area
cases.evidence: Plugins caption opens its vertical submenu at the visible label.

cases.name: List mouse wheel
cases.evidence: Mouse wheel advances the selection and scroll position in the native language list.

cases.name: Right-click context menu
cases.evidence: With general/autohidemouse temporarily disabled only in the isolated profile, right-click opened the populated Moving Pictures context menu from list and thumbnail views. This verifies context-menu support with a visible cursor, not every first click after native cursor auto-hide. The temporary setting was restored.

cases.name: Progress drag/seek
cases.evidence: AnyCPU menu editor 1.39.0.9 handles application-local WinForms pointer messages while retaining bound GUIProgressControl 118. With a paused 180-second synthetic song, forward drag commits 147.86s (UI 2:27), backward drag commits 45.03s (UI 0:45), midpoint click commits 89.95s (UI 1:29). Geometry checks 12/12 pass. Other pages/skins, radio and modal dialogs are excluded.

cases.name: List double click
cases.evidence: Mouse double-click entered the input fixture folder and started the first track after pointer wake-up.
